title: Review: jmap-server crate
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — no security surface, no public API ambiguity. Only gaps are a missing test oracle and a .expect() style issue.
Confidence: 5% chance of missed bug. Least confident: json_pointer_ext wildcard edge cases at spec boundaries (e.g. nested wildcards) — not covered by RFC 8620 so probably not exercised in practice. Would raise confidence if: RFC 8620 §3.7 example payloads were added as test vectors.
Idiom rating: CLEAN — proper Cow<str>, two-phase atomicity, Arc<dyn Trait> pattern, CallerCtx generics, no unsafe. Only gap is the .expect() in library code (filed).
Rust idiom confidence: 5% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: HandlerFuture manual Future pinning could use async_trait but current approach is deliberate and object-safe — not a bug.
